shortDescription: Module to manage Instance Types in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: ballooning_enabled
options.description: If I(true), use memory ballooning. Memory balloon is a guest device, which may be used to re-distribute / reclaim the host memory based on instance type needs in a dynamic way. In this way it's possible to create memory over commitment states.

options.name: boot_devices
options.description: List of boot devices which should be used to boot. For example C([ cdrom, hd ]). Default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: cpu_cores
options.description: Number of virtual CPUs cores of the Instance Type. Default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: cpu_mode
options.description: CPU mode of the instance type. It can be some of the following: I(host_passthrough), I(host_model) or I(custom). For I(host_passthrough) CPU type you need to set C(placement_policy) to I(pinned). If no value is passed, default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: cpu_pinning
options.description: CPU Pinning topology to map instance type CPU to host CPU. CPU Pinning topology is a list of dictionary which can have following values:

options.name: cpu_sockets
options.description: Number of virtual CPUs sockets of the Instance Type. Default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: cpu_threads
options.description: Number of virtual CPUs sockets of the Instance Type. Default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the instance type.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: graphical_console
options.description: Assign graphical console to the instance type. Graphical console is a dictionary which can have following values: C(headless_mode) - If I(true) disable the graphics console for this instance type. C(protocol) - Graphical protocol, a list of I(spice), I(vnc), or both.

options.name: high_availability
options.description: If I(yes) Instance Type will be set as highly available. If I(no) Instance Type won't be set as highly available. If no value is passed, default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: high_availability_priority
options.description: Indicates the priority of the instance type inside the run and migration queues. Instance Type with higher priorities will be started and migrated before instance types with lower priorities. The value is an integer between 0 and 100. The higher the value, the higher the priority. If no value is passed, default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: host
options.description: Specify host where Instance Type should be running. By default the host is chosen by engine scheduler. This parameter is used only when C(state) is I(running) or I(present).

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the Instance Type to manage.

options.name: io_threads
options.description: Number of IO threads used by instance type. I(0) means IO threading disabled.

options.name: memory
options.description: Amount of memory of the Instance Type. Prefix uses IEC 60027-2 standard (for example 1GiB, 1024MiB). Default value is set by engine.

options.name: memory_guaranteed
options.description: Amount of minimal guaranteed memory of the Instance Type. Prefix uses IEC 60027-2 standard (for example 1GiB, 1024MiB). C(memory_guaranteed) parameter can't be lower than C(memory) parameter. Default value is set by engine.

options.name: memory_max
options.description: Upper bound of instance type memory up to which memory hot-plug can be performed. Prefix uses IEC 60027-2 standard (for example 1GiB, 1024MiB). Default value is set by engine.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Instance Type to manage. If instance type don't exists C(name) is required. Otherwise C(id) or C(name) can be used.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: nics
options.description: List of NICs, which should be attached to Virtual Machine. NIC is described by following dictionary. NOTE - This parameter is used only when C(state) is I(running) or I(present) and is able to only create NICs. To manage NICs of the instance type in more depth please use M(ovirt.ovirt.ovirt_nic) module instead.

options.name: operating_system
options.description: Operating system of the Instance Type, for example 'rhel_8x64'. Default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine. Use the M(ovirt.ovirt.ovirt_vm_os_info) module to obtain the current list.

options.name: placement_policy
options.description: The configuration of the instance type's placement policy. Placement policy can be one of the following values: C(migratable) - Allow manual and automatic migration. C(pinned) - Do not allow migration. C(user_migratable) - Allow manual migration only. If no value is passed, default value is set by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: rng_bytes
options.description: Number of bytes allowed to consume per period.

options.name: rng_device
options.description: Random number generator (RNG). You can choose of one the following devices I(urandom), I(random) or I(hwrng). In order to select I(hwrng), you must have it enabled on cluster first. /dev/urandom is used for cluster version >= 4.1, and /dev/random for cluster version <= 4.0

options.name: rng_period
options.description: Duration of one period in milliseconds.

options.name: serial_console
options.description: I(True) enable VirtIO serial console, I(False) to disable it. By default is chosen by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: smartcard_enabled
options.description: If I(true), use smart card authentication.

options.name: soundcard_enabled
options.description: If I(true), the sound card is added to the instance type.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the Instance Type be present/absent. I(present) state will create/update instance type and don't change its state if it already exists.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: usb_support
options.description: I(True) enable USB support, I(False) to disable it. By default is chosen by oVirt/RHV engine.

options.name: virtio_scsi
options.description: If I(true), virtio scsi will be enabled.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.

options.name: watchdog
options.description: Assign watchdog device for the instance type. Watchdogs is a dictionary which can have following values: C(model) - Model of the watchdog device. For example: I(i6300esb), I(diag288) or I(null). C(action) - Watchdog action to be performed when watchdog is triggered. For example: I(none), I(reset), I(poweroff), I(pause) or I(dump).
